questions.question: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, what did the people say they were like?
After the LORD restored the captives of Zion, what was said about them among the nations?

answers.text: The LORD has done great things for them
Their own strength has saved them
Their enemies have grown weary of them

questions.question: The nations said the LORD had done great things for the restored captives of Zion. How did the people answer?

answers.text: They turned it into a question
They said it about the nations
